adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does a non-atomic `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` followed by either `prisma.credential.create(...)` or `prisma.credential.update(...)`. This check-then-act sequence is vulnerable to concurrent requests for the same `(userId, appId)` both seeing no existing row and both attempting `create`, which can result in duplicate credentials if no DB uniqueness exists, or a thrown unique-constraint error if it does. The diff shows no `upsert`/transaction/locking or unique-violation handling in this code path.
